key_concepts: A life cycle is the series of changes in one generation of an organism
Human life cycle includes birth, infancy, childhood, adolescence, and adulthood
Butterflies undergo complete metamorphosis with egg, larva, pupa, and adult stages
Frogs develop from egg to tadpole to froglet to adult through metamorphosis
Cockroaches undergo gradual or incomplete metamorphosis with egg, nymph, and adult stages
Plant life cycle progresses from seed to germination to seedling to mature plant
Complete metamorphosis has four stages while gradual metamorphosis has three stages
Metamorphosis is a biological process of physical development after birth or hatching
Tadpoles have gills and tails, then develop lungs as they become froglets
Plants grow from seeds, develop roots and stems, and later produce flowers and fruits
